note: Subset of a payload recorded by a third-party test suite. No request was made by Vydra.
endpoint: browse (a channel's search tab), WEB client
locale_observed: ru (thousands separators are U+00A0, relative dates are Russian)
reduction: kept the expandable tab that holds the result renderers

that the global search surface nests renderers identically to a channel search tab
any request shape: only responses are represented here
